name: Clasor design system
scope: Live React design system: shared components, tokens and material contracts. No API or authorization changes.

brand.method: Reference sample.webp; approximate sampled pixels. Darker action foreground pairing preserves white text contrast.

rules: One primary action per decision area.
Use a native button; aria-label for icon-only controls.
Loading blocks duplicate submission and retains a visible label.
Disabled reason is persistent outside the control.

material.rule: Shared primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and emblem contracts; retain focus, disabled and opaque fallbacks.
